constraints.explanation: sheets across times the sheet width must equal the tile width
a joint is no wider than the sheet it borders
the joint and the finish together fit inside the height range

controls.explanation: The shadow line where two sheets meet.
controls.label: Joint colour

controls.explanation: The pale grime that settles on a painted panel.
controls.label: Weathering colour

controls.explanation: How many sheets fit across one tile.
controls.label: Sheets across

controls.explanation: How wide one sheet is; sheets times width must equal the tile width.
controls.label: Sheet width

controls.explanation: How wide the groove between two sheets is.
controls.label: Joint width

controls.explanation: How deep the groove between two sheets is.
controls.label: Joint depth

controls.explanation: How many cells of the sprayed finish fit across one tile; more means finer.
controls.label: Finish size

controls.explanation: How far the sprayed finish rises and falls.
controls.label: Finish relief

controls.explanation: How much the sprayed finish shows as a change of tone.
controls.label: Finish tone

controls.explanation: How much the paint on one sheet differs in brightness from the next.
controls.label: Sheet variation

controls.explanation: The most grime lightens the panel, in percent. Low, so lettering over it stays legible.
controls.label: Weathering

controls.explanation: How many patches of grime fit across one tile; more means smaller patches.
controls.label: Weathering patches

controls.explanation: How matte the paint is, in thousandths; a sprayed panel is fairly glossy.
controls.label: Panel roughness

controls.explanation: How matte the inside of a joint is, in thousandths.
controls.label: Joint roughness

controls.explanation: Millimetres between the lowest and highest point the height map can hold.
controls.label: Height range

controls.explanation: How far around each point the surface is compared to find crevices.
controls.label: Occlusion radius

controls.explanation: How far below its surroundings a point must sit to be fully shadowed.
controls.label: Occlusion depth

controls.explanation: The darkest a crevice can get, in thousandths.
controls.label: Occlusion strength
